en.headline: Centre for Food Safety probes suspected Japan import ban breach on dried fish
en.dek: A batch of dried fish product with almond processed in Saitama Prefecture after the 2023 order was sealed during inspection and has not entered the market.
body: The Centre for Food Safety of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said on Thursday that it is investigating a suspected breach of the Food Safety Order after finding a batch of dried fish product with almond during checks on Japanese food imports.

The product was processed in Saitama Prefecture after the order took effect on 24 August 2023. The Centre has marked and sealed the consignment, which has not entered the market. A spokesman said the importer is suspected of breaching the order that prohibits aquatic products from ten Japanese prefectures, including Saitama, if harvested, manufactured, processed or packed on or after that date.
The Centre will continue follow-up action, including informing the relevant Japanese authorities. Prosecution will be considered if there is sufficient evidence. The investigation is ongoing.

zh.headline: 食安中心跟進疑違反日本水產輸入禁令的杏仁魚乾
zh.dek: 一批在2023年命令生效後於埼玉縣加工的杏仁魚乾產品，在進口檢查中被發現並已標示封存，未流入市場。
body: 食物環境衞生署食物安全中心周四表示，在檢查日本進口食物時，發現一批疑違反《食物安全命令》的水產品，正跟進處理。
有關產品是在2023年8月24日命令生效後於埼玉縣加工的杏仁魚乾。中心已將貨物標示及封存，該批產品並未進入市場。發言人指出，輸入商涉嫌違反禁令。該命令禁止來自包括埼玉在內十個日本都道府縣、於該日或之後採捕、製造、加工或包裝的水產品輸入及供應。
中心將繼續跟進，包括通知日本有關當局。如有足夠證據，將對輸入商提出檢控。調查仍在進行中。
